name.full: Agilify IT Bot - laptop and device support

description.short: Laptop status, device runbooks and inventory help for Agilify IT.
description.full: Internal assistant for Agilify's IT support team. Looks up laptop status in Intune, Windows Autopilot and Entra (read-only), walks the IT Support Tech through device runbooks one step at a time, and sends any tenant change to the Approver as a change request. Only members of the IT support groups can use it. BitLocker recovery keys are never shown in chat.

commands.title: Laptop status
commands.description: e.g. What's the status of SERIAL-1?
